name: code4food
description: code4food studio's Claude Code tooling: the dev Skillset (attention-lean workflow) and the Factory (autonomous spec-driven development).

plugins.name: code4food-skillset
plugins.description: Live sessions with a human in the room. A typed flow — chart, grill, spec, tickets, implement — that terminates in factory-runnable backlog tasks, plus the method skills the flow names at its seams. Skills only: no injected contract, no hooks, no agents.

plugins.name: code4food-factory
plugins.description: The skillset a Factory window loads, plus the attended-side factory skills (spec interview, setup wizard). Unattended sessions with no human in the room: how to pick a backlog task, implement it, verify it headlessly, and review it before the PR. The driver, prompts, and schedulers ship in this plugin's factory/ tree and run from a per-machine runtime clone (see FACTORY.md).
